```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
show_project_icons <- function(path = "work_projects") {
  name_projects <- list.files(here::here(path), pattern = "\\.qmd$", full.names = TRUE)
  name_projects <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(name_projects))
  path_icons   <- paste0(path, "/media/", name_projects)
  
  icon_paths <- sapply(path_icons, function(d) {
    files <- list.files(d, pattern = "\\.ico$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(files) < 1) files <- list.files(d, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(files) < 1) {
      return(NA)
    } else {
      return(files[1])
    }
  })
  return(unname(icon_paths))
}

icon_paths <- show_project_icons()

# Chaque icône utilise `dock-url` lorsqu'il est défini dans la page du projet.
# Sinon, on conserve le lien historique https://cmaslard.xyz/<nom_du_projet>/.
for (ip in icon_paths) {
  
  # Le dossier où se trouve l'icône, ex. "work_projects/media/ECODIV_2021"
  project_dir <- dirname(ip)
  # Le nom du projet, ex. "ECODIV_2021"
  project_name <- basename(project_dir)
  project_qmd <- here::here("work_projects", paste0(project_name, ".qmd"))
  metadata <- tryCatch(
    rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(project_qmd),
    error = function(e) list()
  )
  
  link <- if (!is.null(metadata[["dock-url"]])) {
    metadata[["dock-url"]]
  } else {
    paste0("https://cmaslard.xyz/", project_name, "/")
  }
  
  # Affichage HTML : <a href="..."><img src="..." /></a>
  cat(sprintf(
    '<a href="%s"><img src="%s" alt="%s shortcut" style="width:32px; margin: 5px;" /></a>\n',
    link, ip, project_name
  ))
}
```
